name: tinto-rooming-lists
description: Producing a per-tour rooming list with passport details, matching Tinto's real rooming-list format: room/guest/bed-configuration summary plus per-guest passport data, delivered as a workbook (English plus the hotel's own local language when it isn't already English). For a tour with more than one hotel on record, builds one workbook per stop using the `Tour Accommodation` table as the authoritative source of which hotels are involved. Always confirms which specific Tour record is meant when a tour name matches more than one departure, even on a repeat request in the same conversation. Each guest's own name always precedes the passport-not-yet-in-hand marker, so a shared room with more than one guest still missing passport data stays attributable row by row. A standalone plugin, open to anyone on the team who needs it. Rebuilt 2026-09-15 against a real reference template and live production schema; extended 2026-09-16 for multi-hotel tours and live-tested against real booked tours.
